title: Unifying matrix completion across domains with a synthetically pretrained foundation model
abstract: arXiv:2610.06751v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference. While matrix completion provides a common setup for these domains, the best methods in each domain are still specialized and do not transfer well across domains. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot with fixed network weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

translated_title: 通过合成数据预训练的基础模型统一跨领域矩阵补全
translated_abstract: 矩阵补全是从表格数据插补到因果推断等诸多问题的基础。虽然矩阵补全为这些领域提供了统一的框架，但每个领域的最佳方法仍然是专门化的，难以在领域间良好迁移。我们提出了MatrixFormer，这是一个预训练的矩阵原生transformer模型，能够在单次前向传播中为每个缺失条目预测完整的分布。MatrixFormer完全基于合成的低秩矩阵和潜因子矩阵进行训练，并涵盖多种缺失模式。在固定网络权重的零样本应用中，MatrixFormer在因果推断面板数据任务、表格数据插补和推荐系统矩阵补全上均取得了有竞争力的性能。这些结果使MatrixFormer成为矩阵补全领域的通用基础模型。
tldr: MatrixFormer是一个完全基于合成低秩矩阵预训练的矩阵补全基础模型，能在单次前向传播中预测每个缺失条目的完整分布，并以零样本方式在因果推断、表格插补和推荐系统等多个领域取得有竞争力的性能。
en_tdlr: MatrixFormer is a matrix-native transformer foundation model pretrained entirely on synthetic low-rank matrices, which predicts full distributions for missing entries in a single forward pass and achieves competitive zero-shot performance across causal inference, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems.
